title: Friendly guide and beautiful views
text: We had a delay in getting to the ranch, but the staff was incredibly accommodating and we had a wonderful time.
author: William_P

title: Something from a movie!
text: I really enjoyed the activity and felt really comfortable with our guide Lucia (I think her name was). I felt well connected with the horse I was given and felt like I was in a movie. Lucia answered any questions I had. My husband didn’t enjoy it as much, but he isn’t as much of a fan of horses. I would definitely book again.
author: Aisha I

title: Horseback riding in Sierra Nevada,Granada
text: The hospitality shown to us at the Ranch was above & beyond . What an adventure for our love story! The horses were so noble & friendly to us : Kratos & Wetu . Riding up into the Sierra Nevada was  exhilarating ,so beautiful! The conversation with our guide Carlos flowed as he pointed out the facts about our horses, the breed & ranch life -answering all our questions.It was immersive , interactive and we’ll never forget it .Thank you,Don Carlos!
author: Voyager243259

title: Beautiful Ride
text: An amazing ride and beautoful scenery. The place is breath taking. I wouls surely come again. Thanks alot

title: Beautiful experience
text: Round trip was organized and worked great. The riding instructor was very friendly and helpful. The area of the tour is very nice.
author: Vacation35899376443

title: Incredible horse riding experience! Deffo recommend
text: Sebastian, the driver picked us up at our hotel in central Granada at 3pm. It was around an hour drive, with 20min or so off road to the ranch. Winding roads, so if you get car sick, don’t forget to take motion sickness tablets! Carlos, the owner of Mountain Horse Ranch greeted us and introduced us to the horses we would be riding. We spent a little time grooming them, before they were saddled and taken to a small fenced enclosure where we were taught to handle our horse. author: Trail701785

title: Very scenic Horse Ride
text: This was truly one of the highlights of our trips to Spain. I did this with my 21 year old son. We loved the scenery and nature of Sierra Nevada, beautiful views and aromas that you can’t enjoy from the car. The owner of the farm Carlos is a known hose trainer-psychologyst, his wife Olivia and partner came with us and between the two of them we felt comfortable and relaxed. They are warm and very kind, they genuinely cared about our safety. They let my son take off his helmet only for 30 seconds to take a picture:) Their horses were culm and friendly. We both really this!
author: mdubov

title: Horses and mountains
text: The hostess was sweet and kind and the horses purely adorable, they were well treated and loved. It showed. The scenery was beautiful with the mountains and vegetation , I really loved it! ❤️
author: Genevieve_M

title: Horseback riding in the Granada
text: The horseback riding excursion was awesome!  The horses were amazing and my guide, Carlos, was great. We talked all about the countryside, the Andalusion horses and Granada. 5-star experience! Highly recommend.
author: chrissV9298YR

title: Amazing horse riding experience
text: All round amazing experience. It was the highlight of our trip. Carlos and Lydia were exceptional guides. The horses were well trained, gentle and we felt comfortable on them. The saddles are works of art created by the family that owns the horses. Sebastian,  our driver, got us to the location and was friendly and knowledgeable about the area. He even became our personal photographer! Thank you to Mahsa for organising the trip. Thank you Lydia, Carlos and Sebastian.
author: CapeTownFoodie22
